goal: CoolMall Android→HarmonyOS migration, stage 2b semantic extraction: produce one assertion card per area (page cards/domain cards), from which the ledger denominator is frozen
context: Read/write only input/CoolMallKotlin (read-only), output/CoolMallHM/spec/cards (write your own card). Strictly follow the card format in instructionsFile; the parser reads it mechanically.

areas.name: app-init-launch
areas.focus: App startup and launch flow: Application.onCreate initialization (initToast/initLog/initMMKV/initQQ/appState.initialize), MainActivity (edge-to-edge, theme), AppNavHost, splash page LaunchRoutesSplash, guide page LaunchRoutesGuide, first-launch check, theme mode/theme color (core/common ThemePreferenceManager + designsystem theme), global AppState/login state. Also produce a separate INIT-related domain section. Assertion ID prefix: LAUNCH-A01… Card file name: launch.

areas.name: main-home
areas.focus: Home tab (MainRoutesMain hosts the bottom navigation Home/Category/Cart/Me): MainScreen bottom navigation behavior, HomeScreen/HomeViewModel/HomeSkeleton/FlashSaleItem, banner/categories/flash sale/recommended product list/load more/pull-to-refresh/search entry. Assertion ID prefix: HOME-A01… Card file name: main_home.

areas.name: main-category-cart-me
areas.focus: Category tab, Cart tab (MainRoutesCart is also registered as a standalone route), Me tab: CategoryScreen/CartScreen/MeScreen and their ViewModels. Cart select/select all/quantity change/delete/checkout; Me page login state, order entry points, settings entry. Assertion ID prefix: MAIN-A01… Card file name: main_tabs.

areas.name: goods
areas.focus: Goods domain: GoodsRoutesDetail product detail (SKU spec selection/add to cart/buy now/favorite/comments preview), GoodsRoutesComment comment list, GoodsRoutesSearch search (search history/suggestions/results), GoodsRoutesCategory category product list (sort/filter FilterDialog/load more). Assertion ID prefix: GOODS-A01… Card file name: goods.

areas.name: order-a
areas.focus: Order list OrderRoutesList (status tabs/pagination/order action buttons), order detail OrderRoutesDetail, logistics OrderRoutesLogistics. Assertion ID prefix: ORDA-A01… Card file name: order_a.

areas.name: order-b
areas.focus: Order confirm OrderRoutesConfirm (address/coupon/price calculation/submit), payment OrderRoutesPay (Alipay/WeChat/simulated payment, countdown), refund OrderRoutesRefund, comment OrderRoutesComment. Assertion ID prefix: ORDB-A01… Card file name: order_b.

areas.name: auth
areas.focus: Auth domain: AuthRoutesLogin (login method selection/QQ login), AuthRoutesAccountLogin, AuthRoutesSmsLogin (image captcha ImageCaptchaDialog/SMS countdown), AuthRoutesRegister, AuthRoutesResetPassword; input validation (core/util validation), storing the token after successful login. Assertion ID prefix: AUTH-A01… Card file name: auth.

areas.name: user-market-feedback
areas.focus: User domain: UserRoutesProfile profile (avatar/nickname edit/logout), UserRoutesAddressList/AddressDetail address CRUD (RegionPickerModal region selection), UserRoutesFootprint footprints (local database); MarketRoutesCoupon coupons (claim); FeedbackRoutesList/FeedbackRoutesSubmit feedback (image upload). Assertion ID prefix: USER-A01… Card file name: user_market_feedback.

areas.name: cs-chat
areas.focus: Customer service chat CsRoutesChat: WebSocketManager connection/reconnect/connection state, message list/load history ChatLoadMore, ChatInputBar/emoji EmojiSelector/function selector FunctionSelector (images etc.), ChatSoundManager notification sound. Assertion ID prefix: CS-A01… Card file name: cs_chat.

areas.name: common
areas.focus: Common pages: CommonRoutesSettings settings (theme mode ThemeModeModal/theme color ThemeColorModal/clear cache/language etc.), CommonRoutesAbout about (version/links/DependencyModal open-source dependencies), CommonRoutesWeb web page WebView, CommonRoutesUserAgreement/PrivacyPolicy, CommonRoutesContributors contributors. Assertion ID prefix: COM-A01… Card file name: common.

areas.name: data-domain
areas.focus: Domain card (no page): network layer core/network (base URL, interceptors that inject token/handle 401, NetworkResponse wrapper, list of service APIs), core/data Repository + state (login state/cart count etc.), core/database Room (footprints/search history/cart? entities and DAOs), core/datastore (auth/user info persistence keys), core/util storage MMKVUtils/notification/permission/log, core/result. Output backend assertions: endpoints, persistence keys, token injection, logout clearing, cache strategy. Assertion ID prefix: DATA-A01… Card file name: data_domain.
